scientific_integrity: Two-layer local Smith calculation and Möbius inversion prove all primitive-cycle counts; power-of-two family has full closed period distribution. Finite exact checks independently verify matrix, trajectories, and polynomial formulas.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary synchronous neighbor XOR on simple prisms, n>=3; general period counts via gcd rather than explicit possible-period list; prior transient and Jordan prism results are not new; residual specialized-priority risk and no independent audit.
title: Complete primitive-cycle census for binary parity dynamics on prism graphs
